title: Beyond Instruction Following: Evaluating Inferential Rule Following of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the logical capability of Large Language Models to trigger and apply inferential rules across diverse domains such as kinship, law, mathematics, and common sense. While it includes a content moderation dataset (SALAD) as one of its evaluation tasks, the primary research objective is to benchmark the general cognitive and reasoning mechanism of rule-following rather than to evaluate religious, moral, or ethical values themselves.
